content.comment_body: Hello everyone, Is it possible to show the trend view using the webserver? Or is the trend view limited to being displayed only on the physical [product_name] display unit? Any guidance would be appreciated.
The trend curve can only be shown on the actual display of a [product_name] or a real [product_name] TDE display; it can't be displayed on the webserver.
Thank you for the quick response.

analysis.insight_summary: A question was raised about viewing trend curves via the webserver for the [product_name] platform. It was clarified that trend curves are only available on the physical [product_name] display or [product_name] TDE display, not on the webserver, highlighting a limitation in remote access capabilities for trend data.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates that the webserver should support displaying trend views, similar to the physical [product_name] or [product_name] TDE display, for improved flexibility.
